category.quote: Fisheries and Aquaculture farmers having up to 4hectares aquaculture farm size or equivalent unit shall be eligible for one time aquaculture insurance incentive.

gate_notes: Only Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholders involved in the fisheries value chain and registered on NFDP are covered
